name: Hotel Restaurant Pizzeria Haid
beschreibung: The Hotel Restaurant Pizzeria Haid is located in St. Leonhard im Pitztal, nestled in the Ötztal and near the Pitztaler Gletscherwelt. The accommodation offers a combination of hotel rooms and a restaurant with a pizzeria. St. Leonhard lies at about 1,400 meters above sea level and forms the center of the Pitztal.
